messages:
nina: Following up on the pin/rollout metadata RFC. I'm thinking of a compact token approach (<=80 bytes) that is verifiable and leaves full manifest in object store for audits. Quick pros/cons?

reza: +1 on size win. Main tradeoff is expressivity. How much routing info do we bake into token vs keep in routing service?

kai: Runtime needs: model_hash, epoch, rollout_tag, fallback_ptr, expiry, and a short sig. If token packs those, resolver avoids manifest fetch 99% of the time. Keep weights in routing service keyed by rollout_tag.

nina: Agreed. That allows retargeting without repinning. Also propose token prefix like PTK3 and truncated HMAC (8B) to keep size down.

sec-liz: Truncated HMAC ok with rotation + monitoring. Need revoke path for emergency retire. Recommend push-based small denylist to resolvers (in-memory) for hot invalidations.

ops-alex: Ops note: hot KV index currently stores big JSON per-tenant. Replacing with 64-80B token will cut RAM significantly. Migration: dual-write index value: {"token":"PTK3...","manifest_url":"s3://...","manifest_hash":"sha256:..."}. New resolvers prefer token.

reza: Observability: add metrics token.verify_fail, token.fallback_to_manifest, token.expiry_reject. Console: provide an expand API that fetches manifest_url for humans.

kai: Edge: partial rollouts/canaries handled by routing table, good. For targeted rollbacks we push tenant-scoped revoke messages. For massive retirements we publish short hot denylist.

nina: Token sketch (pseudo):
PTK3.<base64(payload)>.sig
payload: tenant_varint | model_hash(20B) | epoch_varint | rollout_tag_varint | expiry(4B opt) | flags(1B) | key_id(2B)
sig = HMAC-SHA256(key, payload)[:8]
Estimated size ~56-72 bytes.

sec-liz: Key rotation: use KMS-managed key, resolvers cache verification keys for ~30s. On verification failures fallback to manifest. Document rotation playbook.

ops-alex: Migration playbook draft: dual-write -> canary resolvers (token-first) -> 2-week metric window (fallback_rate < 0.2%) -> flip default -> continue storing manifests for audit. Include rollback steps.

reza: Action items: 
- @kai: PR to parse PTK3 and verify truncated HMAC (ETA 1w)
- @sec-liz: short note on truncated HMAC risk + KMS rotation plan (ETA 4d)
- @ops-alex: migration playbook + revoke push spec (ETA 3d)
- @nina: Console expand API mock + trace integration (ETA 1w)

deploy-bot: snapshot created: control-plane/rollout-tokens/6211112222

nina: Thanks, we'll sync during design review on Friday. :thumbsup:
